description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: I want to be a better me.
She is the best student in our class.
family.exampleCn: 她是我们班最好的学生。

family.example: We should believe in the goodness of people.
family.exampleCn: 我们应该相信人性的善良。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: good的比较级是better，最高级是best，都是不规则变化。well是副词形式「好地」，它的比较级和最高级也是better和best。

family.example: I'm honest. I always tell the truth.
family.exampleCn: 我很诚实，我总是说实话。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: honest是形容词，变成名词是honesty（把t去掉加y）。加上dis-否定前缀变成dishonest（不诚实的），dishonesty（不诚实）。注意honest的h不发音。

family.example: I want to improve my English.

family.exampleCn: 这个项目是关于自我提升的。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: improve是动词，加上-ment变成名词improvement（改进；进步）。加上self-前缀变成self-improvement（自我提升）。

family.example: I believe I can make it.
She is a believer in hard work.
family.exampleCn: 她相信努力工作的力量。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: believe是动词，believe in sb.表示「信任某人」。加上-f变成名词belief（注意拼写变化：ve变f）。加上-able变成believable（可信的），加上un-前缀变成unbelievable（难以置信的）。

family.example: Small changes make a big difference.
family.exampleCn: 小小的改变带来大大的不同。

family.example: We are in the same class.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: different是形容词，把t变成ce变成名词difference（差异）。加上-ly变成副词differently（不同地）。make a difference是固定短语，表示「有影响；有作用」。

family.example: I want to develop good habits.
The development of technology is fast.

family.exampleCn: 中国是一个发展中国家。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: develop是动词，加上-ment变成名词development（发展）。developing是「发展中的」，developed是「发达的」，注意区分。

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + can/become + ... + by + doing sth.
sentencePatterns.patternCn: 某人可以通过做某事来……
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: We can become better by being honest and hard-working.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我们可以通过诚实和勤奋变得更好。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: by + doing sth. 是方式状语，表示「通过做某事」。by是介词，后面接动名词（动词+ing形式）。

transferExamples.english: You can learn English well by reading every day.
transferExamples.chinese: 你可以通过每天阅读来学好英语。

transferExamples.english: We keep healthy by doing exercise.
transferExamples.chinese: 我们通过运动保持健康。

transferExamples.english: She improves her writing by keeping a diary.
transferExamples.chinese: 她通过写日记提高写作。

transferExamples.english: I make friends by joining clubs.
transferExamples.chinese: 我通过加入俱乐部交朋友。

sentencePatterns.patternCn: 第一，…… 第二，…… 第三，……
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: First, I will limit my screen time. Second, I'm going to help with housework. Third, I will join the speech club.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 第一，我要限制屏幕时间。第二，我打算帮忙做家务。第三，我要加入演讲俱乐部。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: First, Second, Third 是表示顺序的词，用来列举三点内容，让结构更清晰。每一点后面接完整的句子。

transferExamples.english: First, get up early. Second, eat breakfast. Third, go to school.
transferExamples.chinese: 第一，早起。第二，吃早餐。第三，去上学。

transferExamples.english: First, I will study harder. Second, I will exercise more. Third, I will be more helpful.
transferExamples.chinese: 第一，我要更努力学习。第二，我要多运动。第三，我要更乐于助人。

transferExamples.english: First, cut the vegetables. Second, heat the oil. Third, put in the vegetables.
transferExamples.chinese: 第一，切菜。第二，热油。第三，放入蔬菜。

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + be afraid of + 名词/动名词
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: I'm afraid of speaking in public.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我害怕在公共场合讲话。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: be afraid of + 名词/动名词，表示「害怕……」。of是介词，后面如果接动词要变成动名词（ing形式）。

transferExamples.english: He is afraid of making mistakes.
They are afraid of swimming in the sea.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + spend + 时间 + on sth.
sentencePatterns.patternCn: 某人在某事上花费……时间
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Sometimes I spend too much time on my phone.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 有时候我在手机上花太多时间。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: spend time on sth. 表示「在某事上花费时间」。on后面接名词或代词。也可以说 spend time (in) doing sth. 花费时间做某事。

transferExamples.english: I spend two hours on homework every day.
transferExamples.chinese: 我每天花两小时做作业。

transferExamples.english: She spends a lot of time on reading.
He spends too much time on computer games.
transferExamples.chinese: 他在电脑游戏上花太多时间。

transferExamples.english: We spend one hour on sports every afternoon.
transferExamples.chinese: 我们每天下午花一小时运动。

sentencePatterns.textbookExample: I believe I can make it.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: I believe (that)... 后面接宾语从句，that可以省略。make it 是固定短语，意思是「成功做到；成功」。

transferExamples.english: I believe you can do it.
I believe dreams can come true.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：______ is the best policy. (honest)
growthExercises.explanation: Honesty是名词，在句子中作主语。Honesty is the best policy. 诚实是最好的品格。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：You have made great ______. (improve)
growthExercises.explanation: improvement是名词，表示「改进；进步」，作make的宾语。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：we / keep healthy / by doing exercise
growthExercises.answer: We keep healthy by doing exercise.
growthExercises.explanation: by + 动名词短语，表示「通过做某事」。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我害怕在公共场合讲话。
growthExercises.answer: I'm afraid of speaking in public.
growthExercises.explanation: be afraid of + 动名词，表示「害怕做某事」。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我相信我能做到。
growthExercises.answer: I believe I can make it.
growthExercises.explanation: I believe + 宾语从句；make it 是固定短语，表示「成功做到」。
